painpoints.text: Recurrence of already-filed fabro-66db: this run's first two shell calls (sd ready, sd show) both failed with 'mise ERROR Config files in /repos/denkhaus/fabro/.mise.toml are not trusted' and the planner burned extra tool calls on diagnosis + `mise trust` before any tracker read. Fix idea remains pre-trusting the repo mise config in run containers (fabro-66db); until then the planner prompt could mention the one-line `mise trust` recovery.

observations: fabro-f4cd (open, same priority) is a near-duplicate of fabro-7e88: same fast-path rule plus a 'never run sd list to re-confirm a count' clause from an older run; after fabro-7e88 lands, a following run should stale-check fabro-f4cd and likely close it as superseded (its extra clause is already covered by the existing 'do NOT also run sd list' line in the sd command table).
Resolution detection cannot rely on sd exit codes (seeds-cli exits 0 on errors, open fabro-d936) — brief pins the JSON `success` field as the check.
planner.md is not pinned by any test or digest; only run artifacts (`.fabro/reviews`, `.fabro/revisions`) reference it, so this is a safe prompt-only edit.

planner.md step 4 now appears twice (claim at '4.' and brief-writing also numbered '4.'), pre-existing numbering drift that the fast-path edit did not touch — a future seed could renumber step 5 correctly
